answers.q1_what_did_you_play: I played Powder Pop on Fuzzy Wurm Crawler to place a Bomb and reach 3 Sparks, then Bag of Tricks choosing “Spend 3 Sparks: place 3 Bombs dealing 5.” on it, Kaboom! on it, and Quick Fuse on it to detonate all four Bombs.
answers.q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered detonating the four Bombs before playing Kaboom!; with only the printed information, that preserves the same listed damage but changes the timing of Pyro application.
answers.q3_what_it_gave_up: It gave up retaining any of the cards, the 1 Energy spent on Kaboom!, and all 3 Sparks spent through Bag of Tricks.
answers.q4_different_intent: No. The hand contains no printed defensive or intent-dependent effect, and every affordable card can be used against the sole enemy, so a different telegraphed intent would not have changed this line.
